description: GenHTTP 11 on .NET 11 on a custom io_uring server engine (the ioxide runtime) instead of the default socket engine. Uses GenHTTP's published ioxide engine packages (GenHTTP.Engine.Ioxide / GenHTTP.Modules.IoxideFiles, PR #860, merged). Responses go through GenHTTP's own routing + serialization; Postgres rides ioxide.pg (per-reactor ring-native pool) and json-tls rides ioxide.tls (kTLS TX) on :8081.
